BLOOMBERG: Corruption Concerns in Mexico Hit High Under Sheinbaum
May 28, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Bloomberg/AtlasIntel poll: 62% of Mexicans now call corruption the top problem — up 16 points since February. Framed entirely as Sheinbaum's failing. The 16-point spike tracks the exact timeline of US DOJ indictments and saturation media coverage of the Sinaloa governor.

Not mentioned: Mexico froze bank accounts of indicted officials, initiated domestic prosecutions, and Sheinbaum ordered party members to resign if tied to corruption. The perception spike is the US media campaign working — Bloomberg frames the result as Mexico's problem.

• "corruption concerns reached their highest level during Sheinbaum's presidency"

May 22 – May 28

1. BLOOMBERG — "Corruption Concerns Hit High Under Sheinbaum" (🟡) — AtlasIntel poll timed to Sinaloa indictments; omits Mexico froze accounts, opened cases
2. REUTERS — "Congress Backs Foreign Interference as Election Grounds" (🟡) — sovereignty measure gets democratic-concern framing; no mention of hondurasgate
3. CBS/AP — El Chapo's Nephew Captured (🟢) — fair; Garcia Harfuch quoted, Mexican coordination credited
4. REUTERS — Greer: Tariffs to Remain on USMCA Countries (🔴) — US declares permanent tariffs on trade partners; reported as policy, not coercion
5. BLOOMBERG — Banxico Slashes Growth Forecast to 1.1% (🟡) — tariff damage acknowledged deep in article; headline frames it as Mexico's problem

🇲🇽🏭 MEXICO NOW #1 IMPORTER OF US GOODS — $665B IN EXPORTS, $700B PROJECTED

Comce president Sergio Contreras confirmed Mexico surpassed Canada as the top importer of US goods in 2025, supplying 42% of US industry — proof the American economy runs on Mexican supply chains.

Mexico closed 2025 with a record $665 billion in exports — up 7.6% annually — and is projected to surpass $700 billion in 2026. 90% of external sales are manufactured goods. Mexico ranks as the world's 10th largest exporter and 5th largest FDI recipient.

Kenneth Smith, COMCE bilateral committee: "Economic indicators show the agreement faces no collapse risks during this year's review."

🇲🇽🇵🇸 US RE-SANCTIONS UN RAPPORTEUR ALBANESE — DEFYING ITS OWN COURTS

The Trump Treasury Department reincorporated Francesca Albanese — UN Special Rapporteur for occupied Palestinian territories — onto the sanctions list, weeks after a federal judge ruled the sanctions "unduly limited the right to free expression."

Albanese has repeatedly denounced possible war crimes and segregation against Gaza civilians. Her family challenged the sanctions in court since February 2026.

A US judge said it was unconstitutional. The Treasury did it anyway. When the law gets in the way of covering for genocide, Washington ignores it.

🇲🇽🔬 2,400 DRUG LABS DISMANTLED — 17 TONS OF ANNUAL METH CAPACITY WIPED OUT

SEDENA has destroyed 2,325 clandestine drug labs since Sheinbaum took office — 2,214 in Sinaloa alone. The dismantled operations had capacity to produce 17 tons of methamphetamine per year.

General Trevilla: "Those 17 tons will not reach the streets. That is the most important result — millions in losses for criminal organizations."

107,000 troops deployed across 32 states. The Navy separately seized 71.4 tons of cocaine. Mexico doing the work — on its own terms, under its own law.

🔥🇲🇽 PAN-LINKED FIRM AND US ASSET MANAGER CAUGHT RUNNING INTERFERENCE OPS

Contralínea exposes Despacho LBR — founded by associates of Santiago Creel Miranda (PAN) — and Grey Catalyst Asset Management (GCAM), running "narco-government" disinformation campaigns from San Francisco and Zapopan since January 2026.

Among GCAM's associates: J. Hank Rhon III, son of the Caliente betting group owner. All founders under 30 — young operators running old playbooks. Their campaigns include fabricated claims about US Treasury investigations and attacks on Mexico's consular network.

Mexican intelligence agencies are investigating both entities as a national security threat.

🚨🇲🇽 TRUMP ADMIN INFLATED TARIFF REFUNDS BY $10 BILLION

The Trump administration claimed $20.6 billion in tariff refunds were going out to importers after the Supreme Court struck down his IEEPA tariffs 6-3. Turns out the government inflated the number by more than $10 billion, per customs documents obtained by Bloomberg.

Total obligation: $159 billion — the price tag for a tariff regime the court called illegal. And Washington can't even be honest about how much it's returning.

🇲🇽📊 LABOR POVERTY HITS HISTORIC LOW — WAGES BUY MORE THAN EVER

Mexico's labor poverty rate dropped to 30.7% in Q1 2026 — the lowest since INEGI began tracking in 2005. Real income per capita rose 7.4% annually to 3,653 pesos/month, the highest on record.

Rural poverty fell 3.8 points, urban 2.8 — every income quintile improved, formal and informal workers alike. Under the 4T, purchasing power has recovered 154% since 2018, the highest since 1980.

The formula was never complicated: raise wages, stabilize prices, expand social programs. Two decades of data and this is the floor.

🇲🇽📊 BANXICO CUTS 2026 GROWTH TO 1.1% — STILL GROWING THROUGH TARIFF STORM

Banxico lowered its 2026 GDP forecast from 1.6% to 1.1% after a weak Q1, citing US tariff uncertainty and the TMEC review. For 2027, it raised the projection to 2.1%.

The full picture: record FDI at $23.6 billion in Q1, record exports at $72 billion in April, peso at 17.27, inflation down to 4.11%. US consumer confidence just hit its lowest since 1952.

Growing slower isn't collapsing. Mexico is navigating a tariff war designed to punish — and winning on fundamentals.

🇲🇽🌎 SOUTH AFRICA REJECTS TRUMP'S "WHITE CRISIS" NARRATIVE

Trump raised the US refugee cap by 10,000 spots — exclusively for white Afrikaners — claiming they face "racial violence." He excluded South Africa from the Miami G20.

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Chrispin Phiri: the allegations of systematic abuse of Afrikaners have "no basis in reality."

Some beneficiaries of Trump's own refugee program have already returned to South Africa — undermining the entire premise. The playbook: manufacture a crisis, weaponize white grievance, punish a sovereign nation for its domestic policy.
